changes.comment: ai-assist: add IAiCacheRequest (systemBreakpoints + cacheKey), validateAiCacheRequest/validateCacheBreakpoints, and IProviderCompletionParams.cache? — the Anthropic adapter splits system into content blocks carrying cache_control on cacheable-prefix boundaries, and the OpenAI Chat Completions / Responses adapters split the leading system message into content parts carrying prompt_cache_breakpoint, plus prompt_cache_key when cacheKey is supplied. Additive and optional; an un-annotated request is byte-identical to before (C3 of ai-assist-prompt-caching).
